_comment: GATE-F-FULL: the full-chapter instrumented playthrough commissioned by ralph/NEXT_COORDINATOR_FULL_STATE_AUDIT.md Lane 12. LOGIC LANE. This run-local freeze record exists because operator_harness.gd::_freeze_display_claim reads the run directory's own RUN_METADATA.json first and the global ralph/reports/gate-f-candidate/RUN_METADATA.json second; the global one is the 2026-08-27 freeze, claims a flat display_server=X11 under xvfb-run, and therefore CD-8b-refuses every headless segment before step 1 (RIG-T5-1, found by ralph/T5-PLAY). Written BEFORE the run started and never amended mid-run, which is what the harness's own comment requires.
candidate_ref: ralph/GATE-F-FULL, branched from origin/main at 453107fb (LAND-0830J landed 2026-08-30)
binary: $HOME/godot-bin/godot, linux x86_64 editor build, installed from the release URL .github/workflows/ci.yml pins (GODOT_VERSION: 4.7-stable)
save_state: fresh user:// dir at S01; every later segment seeded from the previous segment's exit save
display_server: headless (logic lane, no display server -- honest, matches this process)
purpose: Run the journey chain S01 -> S10e in one save lineage and report how far the Meadows chapter actually runs today, what stops it, and whether the evidence supports a wall-clock estimate for a first clear against the 3-4 hour target. Per the audit directive the GAME is frozen: no changes under scripts/, scenes/, data/, assets/ or shaders/. Only the rig (tools/), tests/ and docs may be fixed.
_what_this_run_can_and_cannot_show: Measured: mechanics, progression, flags, party state, pacing in PLAY seconds, encounter cadence, reliability failures and swallowed input. NOT measured and NOT claimed in either direction: how the chapter LOOKS (the capture lane is not run -- this container has no GPU and a rendered 1920x1080 frame was measured at 12.7 s by Gate F run 2, pricing the capture lane at ~301 hours), device frame rate, GPU time, VRAM, thermals -- all [OWNER-ONLY] per protocol section K. Wall clock on this container is a rig number dominated by a software rasteriser and a cold world stand-up; the play clock is the pacing number.
